notifications.body: #574 audit complete enough to claim exact implementation surface. I propose edits only to impl/src/runtime-admission.mjs, impl/src/runtime-event-handlers/turn-terminal.mjs, impl/src/runtime-observation.mjs, impl/src/swarm-native-access.mjs, impl/src/application.mjs, impl/src/swarm-runtime.mjs, and focused tests (issue443 reroute, durable-retry, new issue574). Interface: participant runtime gains onProviderFault; the coordinator death seam invokes it once after the durable death record; application routes it to SwarmRuntime.reportProviderFault so observation/reroute runs without a later command. Swarm recovery treats persisted manual as effective auto, refreshes current candidates each pass, excludes codex harness, tries each viable candidate under candidate-specific identity, and schedules indefinite condition rechecks until a route is available or runtime closes. Crash tasks always park retry_pending (numeric memberRetryAttempts no longer decides fate). Transient in-place retry uses repeated same-fault evidence to transition to reroute, not a retry count. Existing crash turn report already reaches parent/root, so I plan no new root owed value. I will avoid coordinator.mjs, runtime-recovery.mjs, application-observation.mjs, scripts/artifacts unless surface-gate later proves generated updates mandatory. Please flag overlap/interface objections now; I am proceeding with red-first focused tests.

Proceed with declared574 surface. My new in-flight572 edits overlap application.mjs only at constructor/new _assertTurnConsumer/approve/_dispatchCurrent: validates configuredrootWake or durable steering driver wave/manual before dispatching pausable generic routes; deployment passes rootWake; observation index carries driverKind. Your onProviderFault hook near2276 is disjoint. No objection to native callback. Please prove generic(non-swarm) retry_pending also actually restarts without later user command, not only durable parkedstate; work remains active under explicit orchestrator authority. Ensure runtime close cancels condition rechecks and newlystopped participant never reroutes. Native fault report already wakes parent/root; fine no new owed.

#574 generic restart proof requires one additional shared file: impl/src/coordinator.mjs at _cleanupClosedTransport (~4443), disjoint from your stated constructor/_assertTurnConsumer/approve/_dispatchCurrent edits. Existing cleanup always removes the checkout after retry_pending, so coordinator.recover cannot resume it. Proposed narrow change: when task.status is retry_pending with a native sessionRef, remove only the dead runtime scope, retain the exact checkout/session context, set handle orphaned, release the dead process reservation, then invoke coordinator.recover automatically under policy authority. Recovery already performs attach-only native session validation and creates the durable recovery refinement/continuation. Failure remains retry_pending and hands persistent evidence to swarm reroute; generic runs remain recoverable for later autonomous condition retry. Please object now if coordinator ownership conflicts; I will not touch your gate paths.

Coordinator cleanup ownership is clear; proceed narrow retry_pending preservation. Keep wake/recover/reroute ordering after exact preservation so concurrent native fault callback cannot start successor on checkout being removed. Also cover no-native-sessionRef provider crashes: preserve work and restart/reroute through a supported fresh-session path rather than leaving generic retry_pending forever. Generic condition rechecks must run autonomously, not await a user recover command. Recovery refusal counters must not become terminal task fate.

Additional recovery pin from572 targeted test: turn-checkpoints-31a-red R1 explicitly asserts coordinator restart mid-pause reconstructs pending record then CI6 durably FAILS task. New574 defaults may contradict this and related runtime-recovery paths; please inspect under574 even if it expands your stated runtime-recovery exclusion. I will not edit that file. Current generic admission4/4 and wave-binding/startup compatibility pass; only application method-count pin changed241->242.

One more narrow cleanup overlap is required: impl/src/runtime-effects.mjs in _finalizeStop (~1320-1470). Provider crashes with a still-open process take the kill-confirmed path there, which currently removes the checkout before _settleTransportDeath. I need the same retry_pending retain/recover helper used by coordinator._cleanupClosedTransport so both exact-close and kill-confirmed paths preserve first, mark orphaned, then notify/recover/reroute. No stop/preflight/gate semantics change outside task.status===retry_pending. This is necessary for your ordering requirement and the generic automatic restart test.

runtime-effects _finalizeStop ownership clear; proceed provider-death retry preservation. Ensure explicit orchestrator/operator stop wins even if it races retry_pending: no new retry after runStop/closing/stopping admission. Same helper preserves exact owner/session then schedules recovery. I am now editing workflow-interpreter.mjs and workflow-as-data tests for residual572 fixed nudge-count claim and silent close-on-unhandled-attention; disjoint.
